On February 2, Ant Group's general AI assistant Lingguang announced a comprehensive upgrade to its core feature "Flash Apps," officially launching two new capabilities: "Upload Images to Generate Apps" and "Desktop Widgets." The upgrade integrates nearly 20 API tools, including sound synthesis, large language model (LLM) calls, calendar services, multimodal understanding, text-to-speech, persistent storage, gyroscope, and vibration feedback. After the upgrade, users can not only efficiently create personalized tools but also enjoy real-time feedback and immersive audiovisual-tactile interactive experiences, significantly enhancing both practicality and fun.  

With the "Upload Images to Generate Apps" feature, the system intelligently analyzes image content to replicate UI interfaces, extract structured key information, and recognize scene styles. Combined with personalized instructions, it transforms static images into dynamic, interactive tools with a single click. For example, users can upload images such as student grade sheets or product sales charts to generate online management tools for data visualization and collaboration. This "what you see is what you get" image-to-application model improves efficiency in both office and daily life scenarios. The seamless integration of image recognition and app generation may become a key direction for lightweight application development.  

The newly integrated nearly 20 API tools support diverse scenarios such as life planning, education, learning, and creative interaction, helping users build more feature-rich applications.

Tras la actualización, los usuarios no solo pueden crear herramientas personalizadas de manera eficiente, sino que las aplicaciones generadas también ofrecen retroalimentación en tiempo real y una experiencia interactiva inmersiva audiovisual y táctil, mejorando tanto la utilidad como la diversión. items.title: 万联易达成立产业人工智能研究与应用专家委员会，实现产研双向奔赴
items.raw_excerpt: 当AI从技术概念迈入价值兑现的“深水区”，产研如何深度携手，通力共现产业AI化、技术商业化的价值闭环？ 产业级AI大模型研发过程中存在哪些技术卡点亟待解决？ 前沿AI应用如何穿透复杂的产业链条，真正融入产业决策环境？ ...... 1月30日，万联易达作为推进产业AI大模型在全产业应用落地的领先企业，在京举办“以应用破局·以生态聚力”为主题的“AI+产业发展”专题研讨会。会上，全国首个“产业人工智能研究与应用专家委员会”（下称“专委会”）正式揭牌。 清华大学人工智能研究院常务副院长、欧洲科学院外籍院士孙茂松作为专委会首席顾问，领衔哈尔滨工业大学刘铭教授、中国科学院大学徐俊刚教授、北京理工大学张磊教授、东北大学刘正皓副教授等人工智能技术顾问，共同推动产业AI大模型“万联摩尔”的构建、研发和应用工作，为其下一步发展注入智力支持。 与会嘉宾表示，此次研讨并非单纯的技术展演，而是直面产研断链痛点，基于万联摩尔的全产业AI超级载体定位的路径分析，来构建“AI+数据+场景”铁三角，引领产业智能化迈入全新周期。 万联易达特设“顾问直通车” 随着国家发改委等八部委联合印发《“人工智能+制造”专项行动实施意见》，人工智能被首次明确定位为支撑现代化产业体系的“社会基础设施”。 政策红利持续释放，但AI+产业发展的深层矛盾却日益凸显，“AI研究已经走到了‘世界模型’阶段，但场景应用落地却还处于‘涌现窗口期’。”孙茂松教授在主旨演讲《人工智能和大模型：发展态势及其产业应用》中精准指出这一现状。 清华大学人工智能研究院常务副院长、欧洲科学院外籍院士 孙茂松 在孙茂松教授看来，文本、代码类模型已走到Scaling Law递减阶段，智能涌现随时可能出现；部分专用模型也在训练范式、结构化推理等关键技术上取得突破性进展，“当前正是技术原型与商业应用双向赋能的好时候。”AI在产业落地已经在内外部具备了一定优势

On January 30, Wanlian Yida, as a leading enterprise promoting the application and implementation of industrial AI models across industries, held a thematic seminar titled "AI + Industrial Development" with the theme "Breaking Through with Applications, Gathering Strength with Ecology" in Beijing. Based on the positioning of Wanlian Moore as a comprehensive AI super-carrier for industries, the event analyzed pathways to build the "AI + Data + Scenarios" iron triangle, guiding industrial intelligence into a new cycle. excerpt_i18n.en: The concept of AI in healthcare has been a buzzword in the industry for nearly a decade, yet three formidable gaps persist between laboratory algorithm models and clinical hospital applications: the conflict between data security and utilization, the mismatch between technical barriers and clinical needs, and communication hurdles in cross-disciplinary collaboration. Many well-resourced hospitals have invested heavily in AI systems, only to see them become mere "window displays," while primary care institutions eager for technological empowerment are held back by insufficient operational capabilities and prohibitively high adaptation costs. Amid widespread industry uncertainty where acclaim fails to translate into practical adoption, Inspur Information has provided a replicable solution in Foshan's Nanhai District through a battle-tested "production-research-application" closed-loop model. On January 22, 2026, at the "Artificial Intelligence + Healthcare" Ecological Co-construction Seminar in Nanhai District, Foshan, the "Artificial Intelligence + Healthcare" ecological co-construction framework was officially unveiled. Simultaneously, the "AI-Native Smart Healthcare System," jointly developed over two years by Inspur Information, Tianrui Yijian, and Foshan Nanhai District People's Hospital, debuted as a practical example of "AI+ healthcare." Eschewing conceptual hype, it focuses on real pain points across the entire diagnosis and treatment process. Through a collaborative "production-research-application" mechanism—where hospitals identify needs, enterprises tailor solutions, and platforms provide robust support—AI technology is genuinely embedded in clinical frontline settings and extended to grassroots levels. Framework Launch: The "One Body, Two Wings, Three Drives" Mechanism Born from Practice. Currently, artificial intelligence serves as a core pillar in healthcare for "strengthening primary care, consolidating foundations, and ensuring essential services."
excerpt_i18n.es: El concepto de la IA médica ha resonado en la industria durante casi una década, pero entre los modelos algorítmicos de laboratorio y la aplicación clínica en hospitales siempre han existido tres brechas difíciles de superar: la contradicción entre la seguridad y el uso de los datos, la desconexión entre el umbral tecnológico y las necesidades clínicas, y las barreras de comunicación en la colaboración interdisciplinaria. Muchos hospitales con recursos han invertido grandes sumas en introducir sistemas de IA, que finalmente terminan como "exhibiciones de escaparate"; las instituciones médicas de base anhelan el empoderamiento tecnológico, pero se detienen ante la insuficiencia de capacidad de mantenimiento y los altos costos de adaptación. En un momento de confusión generalizada en la industria, donde hay "más elogios que resultados", Inspur Information ha ofrecido en Nanhai, Foshan, una respuesta replicable para romper el estancamiento, mediante un modelo de ciclo cerrado "producción-investigación-aplicación" probado en la práctica.

NBA legend and the youngest MVP in history, Derrick Rose, personally experienced Dreame's floor washer products at the event and highly praised their cleaning performance and user experience.

Hosting the launch event at Stanford University represents Dreame's further systematic presentation of its technological roadmap, product philosophy, and long-term strategy following CES. If CES serves as a concentrated showcase for cutting-edge global technological achievements, Stanford represents the source and methodology of technological innovation.
